title: QR Share
description: Stops a QR code going out that opens the wrong thing by reading the exact URL back under the code, re-decoding the code it drew to prove nothing was truncated, and warning about localhost, staging, http, invisible characters and links long enough to make a dense code, with one-tap fixes; ships its own dependency-free encoder (byte mode, ECC M).
stops: QR code opens the wrong page
